devices.model: S-Quad legacy sensor / sounder / strobe family
devices.identification_notes: The 2013 range illustration shows a white S-Quad with a strobe lens. Several sensing and sounder variants share the body; read the complete part code on the label.
devices.applicability_limits: Applies to the listed codes in 4188-779 Issue 10 (December 2013). This legacy strobe range is not an EN54-23 VAD reference. Later -VAD, -S and S4T Self-Test variants need their own documentation.

devices.identification_notes: White circular mounting base with a large centre opening and screw terminals. The S4-700 marking is visible in the manufacturer picture.
devices.applicability_limits: This is the standard S4-700 base. Check the complete code; 34000 adapter bases and coloured or specialist variants are outside this card. The detector head is a separate item.

devices.identification_notes: Red square S4 call point with a white operating window, shown without a protective cover. The label and operating element identify the glass or resettable version.
devices.applicability_limits: Covers S4-34800 (glass), S4-34805 (resettable) and their covered 34842/34845 variants. The housing does not establish the element fitted. EP weatherproof and keyswitch variants need separate instructions.

devices.identification_notes: Light-coloured interface module with plug-in green terminals. The photograph shows the module itself, without its optional installation enclosure.
devices.applicability_limits: Low-voltage S4-34450 only. Confirm the code before using a channel diagram; single-input, mains-switching and powered interfaces are different products. The linked 2015 panel document confirms the model and its function.

devices.identification_notes: Red S-Cubed wall sounder with a rounded front. Check S3-V-R on the label: the front shape alone does not distinguish speech from tone-only models.
devices.applicability_limits: The S3-V-R red voice sounder is listed in the 2015 S-Cubed Mark 3 table. This card does not identify a VAD, weatherproof EP or older VP variant by appearance. Check the installed system and firmware.

devices.identification_notes: White round head with an enclosed centre and radial smoke-entry slots. The photograph shows a mounting base and address-card tab; confirm 55000-620APO on the detector label.
devices.applicability_limits: The XP95 range also includes 55000-600 and black 55000-660 variants. Linked documents include the dedicated detector datasheet and a separate mounting-base guide. Confirm the head label, base and control-panel support.

devices.identification_notes: White round head with an open thermistor cage and a yellow central marker in this manufacturer photograph. Check the label for 55000-420APO and the A2S classification.
devices.applicability_limits: This card covers the A2S 55000-420APO, not the CS 55000-401 or intrinsically safe variants. The dedicated detector datasheet distinguishes heat classifications; the separate archive guide covers mounting bases.

devices.identification_notes: White optical head with a solid central disc and slotted surround, shown on a mounting base. Its appearance is similar to XP95; the 58000-600APO label identifies this model.
devices.applicability_limits: The archived datasheet is PP2606/2021 Issue 2; the manufacturer link is PP2606/2026 Issue 4. Response modes and supported features depend on the control panel; a similar housing does not establish protocol or edition.

devices.identification_notes: Low white head with a dark smoke-entry band and an exposed central heat-sensing cage. Confirm SA5100-710APO; the installation guide also describes different 720 and 810 variants.
devices.applicability_limits: The product page and installation guide specify Discovery/CoreProtocol. The 2026 datasheet also lists XP95 in one table but not its technical-data field, so XP95 support is unconfirmed here. Check exact panel and firmware support.

devices.identification_notes: White low-profile detector with a rounded central cap and curved smoke-entry openings. Confirm ORB-OP-12001-APO on the head; the pictured base is a separate component.
devices.applicability_limits: This is the standard optical model, not the ORB-OP-12003 flashing-LED, marine or I.S. variants. The linked installation guide covers the Orbis detector-head family; the manufacturer datasheet identifies the exact model.

devices.identification_notes: White round smoke head with an enclosed centre and angular smoke-entry slots. Confirm 55000-317APO on the label; Apollo uses similar housings across several detector types.
devices.applicability_limits: This card covers the standard 55000-317 optical head. The 316 flashing-LED and 315 magnetic-test variants have separate part numbers. The dedicated manufacturer datasheet is linked; confirm the head, base and control-panel compatibility.

devices.identification_notes: Red square call point with an Apollo-branded resettable element and a round lower front fixing. Check SA5900-908APO; its face resembles the wireless XPander version.
devices.applicability_limits: The 908 is the red wired indoor model. The linked guide also includes coloured and marine variants; their approvals and enclosure details differ. Match the part code and panel protocol before using a procedure.

devices.identification_notes: Red Apollo-style call point with XPander branding, shown with its resettable element operated. Confirm XPA-MC-14101-APO; a similar front is used on the wired Intelligent MCP.
devices.applicability_limits: Wireless XPander device for an appropriate XPander system and interface, not a directly wired loop call point or a REACH device. The linked MK290 guide covers this exact indoor model; older XPA-MC-14006 has different documentation.

devices.model: Intelligent Open-Area Sounder VID (Red / White Flash)
devices.identification_notes: Red open-area sounder with a small clear visual-indicator lens beside the sounder cone. Confirm SA5500-350APO on the label; flash colour cannot be established from an unlit picture.
devices.applicability_limits: This is the white-flash VID model; EN 54-23 VAD coverage is not established by these documents. SA5500-351 uses red flash and SA5501 models have white housings. Tones, volumes and control functions depend on panel support.

devices.identification_notes: White rectangular surface enclosure labelled Intelligent Input/Output Unit, with front status positions. Confirm SA4700-102APO; other interface functions can share similar enclosures.
devices.applicability_limits: The current datasheet lists XP95 and CoreProtocol operation, with Discovery using XP95 behaviour. Input modes and features vary with protocol and panel support. The enclosure photograph cannot identify the connected circuit or its function.

devices.identification_notes: White circular detector mounting base with metal contact groups and a removable XPERT address-card tab. Check the moulding or label for 45681-210APO.
devices.applicability_limits: A base is not a detector. Similar Apollo bases have different electrical functions. The linked document covers XP95/Discovery mounting bases; verify the installed base and detector combination against their exact documentation.

devices.protocol: Mounting base for Soteria / Discovery / XP95
devices.identification_notes: White circular mounting base with a wide cable opening, terminal ring and eight-position XPERT card. Confirm SA5000-200APO; red and black bases have separate part numbers.
devices.applicability_limits: This card covers the white SA5000-200 base, not a complete detector or sounder. Physical fit alone does not confirm enabled functions; check the chosen head, addressing method and control-panel support.

devices.identification_notes: White round detector with a red ring in the manufacturer datasheet. Read the underside code to distinguish it from similar CAST and ActiV heads.
devices.applicability_limits: CA402 uses the CAST protocol. Confirm the CAST version of the panel and the correct base. Ring colour is a visual clue; it does not identify configuration or prove compatibility on its own. Linked manufacturer datasheet: DFU4020000 Rev 7, 05/08/21.
devices.image_credit: C-TEC manufacturer datasheet image, via Acorn Fire & Security

devices.identification_notes: White round detector with a blue ring in the manufacturer datasheet. Read the underside code to distinguish it from similar CAST and ActiV heads.
devices.applicability_limits: CA414 uses the CAST protocol. Confirm the CAST version of the panel and the correct base. Ring colour is a visual clue; it does not identify configuration or prove compatibility on its own. Linked manufacturer datasheet: DFU4140000 Rev 7, 05/08/21.
devices.image_credit: C-TEC manufacturer datasheet image, via Acorn Fire & Security

devices.identification_notes: White round detector with a grey ring in the manufacturer datasheet. Read the underside code to distinguish it from similar CAST and ActiV heads.
devices.applicability_limits: CA416 uses the CAST protocol. Confirm the CAST version of the panel and the correct base. Ring colour is a visual clue; it does not identify configuration or prove compatibility on its own. Linked manufacturer datasheet: DFU4160000 Rev 8, 05/08/21.
devices.image_credit: C-TEC manufacturer datasheet image, via Acorn Fire & Security

devices.identification_notes: Seven-terminal circular base, shown in the manufacturer wiring leaflet. This drawing shows the base without a detector head.
devices.applicability_limits: CA408 standard base only. A similar circular base or relay-base variant can require different wiring; check the moulded code and the matching leaflet.
devices.image_credit: C-TEC manufacturer illustration, via C-TEC Technical

devices.model: CA470 CAST red manual call point
devices.identification_notes: Red call point with an inward-arrow operating window and fire symbol. The manufacturer picture shows the standard surface-style housing.
devices.applicability_limits: CA470 is the red CAST model with a resettable element. Check the code: other colours, conventional models and the CA47067 weatherproof enclosure have different scope.
devices.image_credit: C-TEC manufacturer datasheet image, via Acorn Fire & Security

devices.identification_notes: Rectangular grey CAST faceplate with Active, Polling and Input Fault indicators. Check CA730 on the module label.
devices.applicability_limits: CA730 low-voltage I/O module only; CA731 mains-switching and other interfaces are separate models. The installation sheet provides the applicable monitored-input, relay and enclosure requirements.
devices.image_credit: C-TEC manufacturer datasheet image, via Acorn Fire & Security

devices.identification_notes: Clear-bodied base device with a directional optical lens, shown without a detector head or a finishing cap. Read the CA459A/W code on the device.
devices.applicability_limits: This is a visual alarm device without a sounder. It is the corridor O-Class version; orientation matters. Do not substitute CA432A/W sounder/VAD or C-Class models from appearance alone. The linked DFU4315010 Rev 15 leaflet also covers sounder variants; use the CA459A/W row.
devices.image_credit: C-TEC manufacturer datasheet image, via Acorn Fire & Security
